mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.published_bundle_snapshots (game_id, version_id, version_code, bundle_json) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{versionId}, #{versionCode}, CAST(#{bundleJson} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT (game_id, version_code) DO UPDATE SET version_id = EXCLUDED.version_id, bundle_json = EXCLUDED.bundle_json, updated_at = NOW()
